description: MainActivity.java defines an Android Activity that serves as a launcher/dashboard for different sample activities, presenting them in a grid view and handling item clicks to start selected samples.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a grid of sample activities, allowing users to launch them by clicking on grid items.

classes.name: MainActivity.SampleAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class providing data and views for the GridView of samples.

classes.name: MainActivity.Sample
classes.description: A data holder class representing a sample activity, including resource IDs for title and description, and an intent to launch the activity.

methods.name: MainActivity.onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the grid and sample list.

methods.name: MainActivity.onItemClick
methods.description: Handles grid item clicks, launching the selected sample activity.

methods.name: MainActivity.SampleAdapter.getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of sample items.

methods.name: MainActivity.SampleAdapter.getItem
methods.description: Returns the sample item at a given position.

methods.name: MainActivity.SampleAdapter.getItemId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for the item at a position.

methods.name: MainActivity.SampleAdapter.getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view to represent a sample item in the grid.

methods.name: MainActivity.Sample
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sample data with resource IDs and activity intent.
